{{PAGENAME}} is a crafting resource that can be processed at either stone cutter from [[marble block]]s. They are primarily used to produce higher tier [[graveyard]] decorations.

Marble sources can be found at [[Witch Hill]] or at the [[marble quarry]] in the north-west area of the [[map]] near the [[cabin in the woods]]. It's also possible to have them mined automatically by using a [[zombie marble quarry]] or to buy them from [[Cory]], the engineer, for quite a pretty penny.

There is no separate [[stockpile]] for marble, and blocks are instead stored together with [[stone block]]s on the [[stone stockpile]].
